== Summary ==
USGS NAIP aerial photograph of the hotel at 3011 Maingate Lane, Kissimmee, Florida, the Doubletree Resort and Conference Center site of DecipherCon 2000. Public domain (U.S. government work).

* Source: [https://imagery.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/USGSNAIPImagery/ImageServer USGS NAIP Imagery ImageServer]
* Export: bbox -81.5886,28.3359,-81.5866,28.3378 (EPSG:4326), 2000×1500 JPEG
